title: Restore canonical PG lineage reads after telemetry process restart
summary: Restores canonical PostgreSQL lineage reads after telemetry service restart or cache loss. Implements tenant-scoped, fetch-bounded build_postgres_event_reader in services/telemetry/ingest_svc.py to query stored events and binding events from PostgreSQL with explicit parameter filtering. Wires on-demand event and binding hydration into LineageReadService (services/telemetry/lineage_read/service.py) resolving immutable provenance directly from PostgreSQL and the authoritative RuntimeBinding store without re-ingest or live replay. Enforces strict provenance validation: unverified bindings without authoritative backing or persisted status fail closed (404) without manufacturing active state, resolving the exact 961 coordinator counterexample. Preserves paused historical canonical bindings as read-only history without reactivation. Enforces strict fail-closed tenant scoping (HTTP 404) and PostgreSQL unavailability (HTTP 503). Uses an owned disposable PostgreSQL container for test verification without falling back to shared/hosted DSNs or deleting real records.

acceptance_verification.description: Source-only restart counterexample reproduction without speculative incident repair. Kept #6486 DONE cardinality and tenant fix intact; existing telemetry owner and Postgres only.

Reproduced immutable acknowledged C6 event d39cabae-3276-4af1-a017-f4c171161ad4 (tenant-dev) and paused binding 63be event 69fff59d-83c9-4cf6-b4a7-9deb5d0a5236: both return 404 before PG reader hydration on fresh process instance and resolve with 200 after restart.

Fixed canonical lineage reader to resolve durable accepted Postgres event and binding identity after fresh process or cache loss without replay or re-ingest into live memory. Supported paused historical canonical bindings as read-only history (status: paused) without reactivating or changing them. Unverified bindings without status fail closed without manufacturing active status.

Preserved strict explicit tenant and environment scope and shared-token allowlist. SQL reader is tenant-scoped and fetch-bounded. Unknown or foreign tenant target fails closed with 404; PG unavailable fails closed with 503.

Preserved immutable accepted payloads and PG truth, avoiding unbounded whole-database graph bootstrapping and SQL per historical row. Reused bounded tenant-scoped queries and validated live-lineage builders.

Actual owner-data persistence and restart regression tested against owned disposable PostgreSQL container: event trace and runtime binding projection resolve the stored event without re-ingest after new reader/service instance; wrong tenant returns 404; unavailable PG returns 503; unverified binding without status returns 404. Test harness cleans up owned container without touching shared DSNs.
Only six declared files touched; net production lines (+115) strictly within budget (<= 120). No credentials, capital, governance, or market schedule changes.
Source-only QA delivery ready for independent review and native delivery.
